slides.text: The slide is not the talk.
slides.sub: Designing decks that serve the speaker, not replace them.
slides.notes: Welcome. Today is about a simple idea: the slide is punctuation, not the script.

slides.text: What is a slide actually for?
slides.notes: Ask it plainly. Most decks answer this wrong.

text: A single beat the room can feel.
slides.notes: A slide is not where you hide your notes. It is one beat, felt at a glance.
The unit of a great deck is one idea per slide. Nothing more.
The method: take the script, explode it to one idea per slide, write the notes, build, and check by eye.
Three rules: big type with room to breathe, one idea per slide, and let the speaker carry the detail.

slides.text: Make the slide disappear behind the idea.
slides.notes: If people remember the idea and not the slide, you have done it right. Thank you.
